params.body:
## What

On the Bouwsoft page the five period choices (7 dagen up to 3 jaar) stood without a label next to labelled Van, Tot and Zoeken fields, as loose grey text that barely showed which one was on.

They are now one segmented control under the label "Periode, tot vandaag", the same height and border as the fields beside it. The chosen span has the light green fill the panel toggles use, and each button carries aria-pressed.

## Checks

- 345 PHP tests and pint pass. Checked on a demo copy.
